title: Linkding stuck Pending for seven hours
impact: Old pod stuck Terminating, replacement stuck Pending, one node NotReady.
cause: A worker laptop went to sleep. The local-path volume is pinned to that node, so nothing else could take the pod.
fix: Woke the laptop. Kubernetes recovered on its own.
lesson: Disable sleep on every node, and read the scheduler's per-node reasons before guessing.

title: The PVC that never showed up
impact: No storage created even though Flux had the commit.
cause: Switching to Recreate clashed with rollingUpdate fields Kubernetes had filled in by default. Flux's dry-run rejected the whole kustomization.
fix: Deleted the Deployment and let Flux rebuild it clean.
lesson: Check flux get kustomizations first. Set Recreate in the first commit, not later.

title: TLS handshake failure on a public hostname
cause: Cloudflare Universal SSL only covers one subdomain level. links.lab.example.com was one level too deep.
lesson: A TLS error can come from the name, not the setup.

title: Flux bootstrap refused
impact: Lost an afternoon before the cluster had GitOps at all.
cause: The fine-grained GitHub token had no Administration permission, which repo creation needs.
fix: Used a classic token with the full repo scope.
lesson: Check token scopes, then GITHUB_TOKEN, then the repo name, in that order.

title: Capstone deploy broken by one stray letter
impact: Flux apply failed on the first line of a manifest.
cause: An extra vim i turned apiVersion into iapiVersion.
lesson: Run head -1 on anything you pasted.
